description: Rank study programs abroad for a student profile: level, fields, countries, budget, language test scores, GPA. Returns a ranked list with score (0..1), bucket (safe, moderate, ambitious), reasons and gaps with stable codes, «what widens the choice» hints, and a consultation link. Do not send names or contact data.

locale.description: Language of the texts of reasons and gaps (default ru)

profile.description: Student profile without names or contacts

budget.description: Budget per year; omit if unknown

scope.description: tuition only, or total = tuition and living costs (default)

destinations.description: Where to study: mode plus countries or regions

countries.description: Country slugs (germany, netherlands, united-kingdom) or ISO alpha-2, up to 5

mode.description: countries or regions as listed, any country, or cheap (any country, cheapest first)

regions.description: Region slugs: europe, asia, north-america, oceania, middle-east ...

directions.description: 1-3 fields: slugs of stadika.ru/specialties/{slug} (e.g. informatika-i-it, psikhologiya) or discipline slugs of search_programs facets

grades.description: Average grade of the last diploma or school certificate

gpa.description: Average grade in the given scale, e.g. 4.5 on scale 5

languages.description: Languages the student knows, with CEFR level or test score

start_year.description: Year of the start of study

target.description: Catalog: abroad (programs abroad); Russian universities and colleges come later

name: match_profile
title: Подбор программ по профилю
